svg.title: Cozy Night Window — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A sleeping cat with an unmistakable feline head, ears, muzzle, curled body, and tail on a cushion beneath a moonlit window. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
